about: The factions and teams completeness sweep (October 2026). The owner's rules: every organization a person served on screen counts, willingly or not (brainwashed, coerced and undercover service included; the steps say how), and Gamora and Nebula served the Black Order. Eight slices, every addition sourced. villain_memberships feed raft_teams.json (with raft_teams_src.json from the first sweep); hero_sets became audit_fix.json ops; org_files became group files. name_map reconciles the names the slices chose differently. hand lists what was set by hand after the consistency checks (a person's hero and villain files list the same groups; open past memberships closed).
